resources.string: The Firefox web engine and real browser extensions, with the Rocks interface.
Drag left or right to move between pages. Short drags snap back; a quick flick switches to the adjacent tab. A second tab is already open.

A separate preview that can coexist with Rocks. Up to 8 tabs, kept during this process only. Bookmarks, download management, camera/microphone/location permissions and private browsing are not included. Extensions and their settings persist.
Install Rocks Paper and open its panel on a website, or install an extension from Mozilla. This demo offers three extensions.
A Rocks reading extension. Change page background and text spacing without a network download.
Apply dark reading styles to websites. Use its panel to enable or disable dark mode for each site.
Filter ads and some tracking requests. Its panel shows filtering activity for the current website.
Bundled with the app · Rocks demo extension
Mozilla add-ons · Internet required to install
After installation, visit a website and open the panel from Extensions. Changing extension state reloads pages. If Mozilla is unreachable, try Rocks Paper. This is not the Chrome Web Store.
